name: speaky
description: ローカル英会話学習アプリ(Local English conversation practice with Whisper + Ollama)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n FE,BE -c blue,green "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run dev -w backend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend
scripts.test: npm test -w frontend && npm test -w backend
scripts.dist: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build:bundle -w backend && npm run prep:vendor -w backend && npm run prep:vendor:whisper-cli -w backend && npm run prep:vendor:whisper-model -w backend && npm run prep:vendor:llama-model -w electron && npm run prep:vendor:ollama-binary -w electron && npm run verify:arm64 -w backend && npm run build -w electron && npm run dist -w electron
